Bettina, I've saved a draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It is in your mailbox and nothing has been sent.

I couldn't edit Sofia's earlier draft, since my tools can only create new drafts. So this is a new draft based on her note. It includes the line that the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments and the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. It ends with a bare "Thanks," so add your name or Sofia's before sending. If you'd rather keep Sofia's original, it is still in her drafts.
